content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Conventional platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy offer managed services: payment processing, product hosting, and delivery in exchange for fees and platform lock-in. Sovereign commerce stacks invert this model. They use open infrastructure—GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase—to give creators full ownership of their store, payments, and data. No platform fees. No account suspensions. No geographic restrictions. The tradeoff? You own the maintenance. The reward? You own the infrastructure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude entire countries based on regulatory risk, not technical limitations. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy inherit these restrictions because they rely on Stripe and PayPal. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. They use on-chain crypto payments (NOWPayments) that settle directly to your wallet—no intermediary required. This is not a workaround. It is a structural alternative. If your country is excluded from conventional platforms, sovereign infrastructure is the only permanent solution.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction—if they are available in your country. Sovereign stacks use NOWPayments, which charges 0.5% with no monthly fees. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks (BSC, Solana, TRON) keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost difference? Conventional platforms can suspend your account and hold funds for 180 days. Sovereign stacks cannot suspend anything—you own the wallet. This is not a fee comparison. It is a risk comparison.
Stripe operates in 46 countries. Sovereign stacks operate in 195.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your customer data, payment history, and product files. They can change their terms or shut down your account at any time. Sovereign stacks deploy your store to infrastructure you control. Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Supabase stores your orders. Google Drive delivers your files. NOWPayments verifies payments. Automation is built into the stack—no manual intervention required. The handoff is complete. COREMERCH has no access after deployment. This is not shared hosting. It is infrastructure sovereignty.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you are in a country where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy operate, conventional platforms are simpler—until they suspend your account or change their terms. If you are in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or any excluded country, sovereign commerce infrastructure is your only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys a complete stack in 48 hours—Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments—with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. The choice is clear. Rent infrastructure you do not control, or own infrastructure that cannot exclude you.

Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

PayPal operates in these countries but frequently suspends accounts without warning—holding funds for up to 180 days. Sovereign commerce stacks bypass PayPal entirely by using on-chain crypto payments (NOWPayments) that settle directly to your wallet. This eliminates the risk of account suspension or fund holds.
